purpose: Deterministically map specific ICAO aircraft type designators from flight-level exposure sources to BSFM cohorts without fleet-share or other proxy allocation.
rules: Only explicitly allowlisted designators map to a canonical exposure cohort.
Unknown, generic, future or ambiguous designators remain unmapped until reviewed and versioned.
No aggregate Boeing 737 value may be split into Original/Classic/NG/MAX by fleet share, deliveries, market share, accident counts or another proxy.
A mapping update must be versioned if it changes historical cohort assignment.
known_future_gap: Future Boeing variants/designators not listed here remain fail-closed until an authoritative designator is published and reviewed.
